verdict.rationale: Floot's core interaction model is natural language. It turns a plain-language description into a deployed full-stack app, and users can say things like "make this a mobile app", describe integrations to the assistant, or ask it to restore checkpoints. It can also be driven from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other clients via MCP. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work as documented.
